## Industrial & Applied Research

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
### 3D Scene Reconstruction with Deep Learning (Leonardo Divisione Velivoli)
**Focus:** Computer Vision &bull; 3D Deep Learning &bull; Aerospace Applications  
**Tools:** PyTorch, OpenCV, Point Clouds, Photogrammetry

During my curricular internship at **Leonardo Divisione Velivoli** in Turin as part of the MPM Master's program:
- Investigated neural approaches to 3D scene reconstruction from 2D aerial imagery.
- Explored hybrid solutions combining traditional geometric computer vision with modern deep learning representations (e.g., neural implicit fields and deep stereo) to overcome limitations in classical photogrammetry under challenging illumination and sparse keypoints.
:::

## Machine Learning & AI Implementations

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple" icon=false}
### Reinforcement Learning: PPO Agent on CartPole
**Focus:** Policy Gradient Methods &bull; Continuous/Discrete Control &bull; Agent Visualization  
**Tools:** Gymnasium, Stable-Baselines3, PyTorch  
- Implemented and trained a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent to balance the CartPole environment for 200 consecutive steps.
- Produced video recordings contrasting untrained random policies with the converged neural policy.  
[Read the Technical Walkthrough &rarr;](blog/post_18-09-24.qmd)
:::

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple" icon=false}
### Dimensionality Reduction: PCA & Eigenfaces from Scratch
**Focus:** Spectral Decomposition &bull; Image Compression &bull; Subspace Learning  
**Tools:** Python, NumPy, scikit-learn, Matplotlib  
- Derived and implemented Principal Component Analysis (PCA) directly from eigendecomposition of the covariance matrix.
- Evaluated 90% variance subspace projection on the Olivetti Faces dataset, validating results against `sklearn.decomposition.PCA`.  
[Read the Technical Walkthrough &rarr;](blog/post_08-11-24.qmd)
:::

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple" icon=false}
### Non-Parametric Classification: KNN Algorithm from Scratch
**Focus:** Metric Spaces &bull; Majority Voting &bull; Decision Boundary Visualization  
**Tools:** Python, NumPy  
- Built a vector-accelerated $k$-Nearest Neighbors classifier from fundamental Euclidean distance metrics without external ML libraries.
- Demonstrated classification boundaries and confidence distributions on the Iris dataset.  
[Read the Technical Walkthrough &rarr;](blog/post_11-09-24.qmd)
:::

## Mathematics & Academic Publications

::: {.callout-important appearance="simple" icon=false}
### Publication: Hardy's Inequality for Pseudo-Differential Operators
*Bollettino dell'Unione Matematica Italiana* (Springer, 2023)  
**Authors:** M. Aldovardi, et al. &bull; [DOI: 10.1007/s40574-023-00359-7](https://doi.org/10.1007/s40574-023-00359-7)

Investigates extensions of fractional Hardy inequalities within the framework of pseudo-differential operators, deriving Sobolev space bounds and regularity properties relevant to mathematical physics and harmonic analysis.
:::

::: {.callout-important appearance="simple" icon=false}
### Master's Thesis: Littlewood-Paley Theory in Harmonic Analysis
*University of Pisa, Department of Mathematics* (2022)  
**Advisor:** Prof. Marco Ghimenti &bull; [Read at ETD Pisa](https://etd.adm.unipi.it/theses/available/etd-10012022-110009/)

Explores dyadic decompositions, multiplier theorems, and the foundational role of Littlewood-Paley square functions in modern partial differential equations and function space theory ($L^p$, Besov, Triebel-Lizorkin).
:::
